pt.doc.title: Guilherme Eccel Superti — Designer
pt.hero.mascot: Dar um oi para o mascote
pt.about.title: Quem sou eu
pt.about.p1: Guilherme Eccel (nascido em 2002 em Porto Alegre-RS) é um designer, editor de vídeo, artista 3D e ilustrador brasileiro. É bacharel em Design pelo Instituto Federal de Santa Catarina (IFSC), em Florianópolis. Trabalhou na A3 Design entre 2024 e 2025 e desde então atua como freelancer.
pt.about.p2: Domina diversos softwares criativos, incluindo Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Affinity, Canva, Blender e Clip Studio Paint, além de outras ferramentas de design, ilustração, modelagem 3D e produção audiovisual.
pt.about.v5: +5 anos em design · A3 Design (2024–25) · Hortifruti Rama Forte (2026) · Tavi Studio (2026)

en.doc.title: Guilherme Eccel Superti — Designer
en.about.title: About me
en.about.p1: Guilherme Eccel (born in 2002 in Porto Alegre, Brazil) is a Brazilian designer, video editor, 3D artist and illustrator. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Design from the Federal Institute of Santa Catarina (IFSC) in Florianópolis. He worked at A3 Design from 2024 to 2025 and has been freelancing ever since.
en.about.p2: He is proficient in a wide range of creative software, including Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Affinity, Canva, Blender and Clip Studio Paint, as well as other tools for design, illustration, 3D modeling and video.
en.about.v5: 5+ years in design · A3 Design (2024–25) · Hortifruti Rama Forte (2026) · Tavi Studio (2026)

ja.about.title: 自己紹介
ja.about.p1: Guilherme Eccel(2002年、ブラジル・ポルトアレグレ生まれ)は、デザイナー、動画編集者、3Dアーティスト、イラストレーターです。フロリアノーポリスのサンタカタリーナ連邦教育機関(IFSC)でデザインの学士号を取得。2024年から2025年までA3 Designで勤務し、その後はフリーランスとして活動しています。
ja.about.p2: Adobe Illustrator、Photoshop、Premiere Pro、After Effects、Affinity、Canva、Blender、Clip Studio Paintをはじめ、デザイン、イラスト、3Dモデリング、映像制作のための幅広いツールを使いこなします。
